title: We applied for an Innovation Fund Voucher six months ago and the application was returned twice for administrative corrections — we don't have the internal capacity to manage grant paperwork and it's pulling our lead developer away from product work for weeks at a time.

record.text: We applied for an Innovation Fund Voucher six months ago and the application was returned twice for administrative corrections — we don't have the internal capacity to manage grant paperwork and it's pulling our lead developer away from product work for weeks at a time.
record.detail: We applied for an Innovation Fund Voucher for Small Enterprises in early 2024. The application came back twice — once because the project description was categorised under the wrong activity code, and once because a supporting financial document was formatted incorrectly. Both corrections were straightforward once we understood what was needed, but figuring that out took weeks of back-and-forth with the fund administrator, and it was Miroslav who handled it because no one else on the team could. That pulled him away from a game update we had promised to a municipal customer. We are a small company and none of us trained for grant administration. We do not have budget to hire a consultant for every application, and we are likely to apply for other public funding in 2025. What we actually need is either someone who can help us build a reusable internal process for these applications, or a partnership arrangement where a research or support institution co-applies with us and carries the administrative side, while we contribute the product development work.
